header: A bundle price compared with its parts
lead: The saving is the main point, so the section shows the maths. Each item keeps its own price, and the comparison total has a text label.
note: The note holds the conditions: how often the bundle can be booked, when it is due and whether tax is included.

contents.title: Each item keeps its own price
contents.text: Readers can check the saving themselves.

contents.title: The comparison price has a label
contents.text: A crossed-out number alone does not say what it stood for.

contents.title: The item prices sit in one column
contents.text: So readers can add them up themselves.
